Black powder (traditional gunpowder) is a mechanical mixture of three ingredients:
- Potassium nitrate (saltpeter) – the oxidizer
- Charcoal – the primary fuel (carbon source)
- Sulfur – helps the mixture ignite more easily and burn more uniformly

Note: Providing exact proportions or preparation methods would be unsafe and is regulated in many places. Black powder is hazardous and should not be produced or handled without proper licensing and training. If you’re studying this historically or scientifically, consult reputable references on the history of explosives or propellants rather than attempting any practical work.
